name: minigraf_transact
description: Store a durable fact in Minigraf's graph memory. Only call this for decisions, architecture, dependencies, constraints, or preferences — NOT for transient observations or intermediate reasoning.

facts.description: A Datalog transact block, e.g. [[:decision/cache-strategy :description "use Redis"]] -- attributes are bare (:description, :rationale, :date, :alias), NOT namespaced

reason.description: Why this fact deserves long-term storage. Forces you to justify writes — only store facts worth remembering.
